mod child;

#[cfg(feature = "inactive")]
mod dormant {
    fn probe() { omitted()?.map_err(opaque)?; }
}

fn pipeline() -> Result<(), Error> {
    input().map_err(Error::from)?;
    option().ok_or(Error)?;
    option().ok_or_else(|| Error)?;
    if let Err(error) = operation() { return Err(error); }
    match operation() { Ok(_) => (), Err(error) => return Err(error), }
    match operation() { Err(error) | Ok(error) => (), }
    match operation() { ::Err(error) => (), }
    match operation() { other::Err(error) => (), }
    match operation() { Err => (), }
    if let other::Err(error) = operation() { return Result::Err(error); }
    let _ = || { closure()?; };
    async { deferred()?; };
    fn nested() { object.0.field.map_err(convert)?; }
    custom!(ignored()?);
    std::assert!(ignored()?);
    return Err(make::<Vec<u8>>());
}

struct Holder;
impl<T> Holder {
    fn method() {
        <Self as Contract>::source().map_err(convert)?;
        (&holder).field.ok_or_else(|| Error)?;
        function_returning_function()().map_err(convert)?;
        return Err(external::make!());
    }
}
trait Contract {
    fn default_method() { source()?; fn nested_default() { source()?; } }
}
impl Contract for &Holder {
    fn method() { source()?; }
}

const CONSTANT: () = { factory()?.map_err(convert)?; };

mod inline {
    fn outer() {
        mod nested { fn leaf() { source()?; } }
        source()?.ok_or(Error)?;
    }
}

#[cfg(
    /* skip exactly cfg(test), including comments */ test
)]
mod tests { fn excluded() { source()?; } }

#[cfg(any(test, feature = "inactive"))]
mod included { fn check() { source()?; } }

    a_really_long_unicode_éééééééééééééééééééééééééééééééééééééééééééééééééééééééééééééé().map_err(convert)?;
    return Err(aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa);
}
